{#- Feedback links for the footer of every page. See review section 14.5. Three subjects rather than one generic "contact", because a prefilled subject is the difference between mail that can be triaged and mail that cannot. The body carries the page and the release, so a report says where it came from without the reader having to go and look either up -- which they will not do. Built at build time from `pagename` and `release`, not by JavaScript, so the links work in a saved or offline copy of the docs too. -#} {#- `feedback_to` comes from html_context in conf.py, so the address is written down once and the inline link on "What do you want to know?" uses the same one. -#} {%- set feedback_where = "\n\n\n-- do not delete: this says where the report came from --\nPage: " ~ pagename ~ "\nSpectroscoPy: " ~ release ~ "\n" -%} {%- set bug_body = "What I did:\n\nWhat I expected:\n\nWhat happened instead:\n\nIf there is an error message, please paste it here:\n" ~ feedback_where -%} {%- set feature_body = "What I would like to be able to do:\n\nWhy -- what I am trying to find out:\n\nIf you have a data file that shows the need, please attach it.\n" ~ feedback_where -%} {%- set question_body = "The question I arrived with:\n\nThe instrument or data I have:\n\nHow I do this at the moment, if I do:\n" ~ feedback_where -%}
